label: Bible Study
prompt: And whatsoever ye do in word or _____, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verse: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
note: Words and deeds alike, done in Jesus' name, with thanks attached.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in _____ by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verse: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
note: Moses blesses Benjamin, 'the beloved of the LORD': safe all day long, resting between God's shoulders.

label: Sunday School
prompt: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an _____ very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
verse: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
note: When the priests' feet touched the Jordan, the river stood up in a heap far upstream — and Israel walked across.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the LORD thy God is a _____ fire, even a jealous God.
verse: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
note: Moses warns against carved idols: Israel's God burns with holy jealousy over his people.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their _____.
verse: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
note: God's people became lost sheep, led astray by their shepherds, until they forgot their 'restingplace.'
